questions.question: [Electricity and Circuits] A 12 V battery with internal resistance 0.5 Ω is connected to a 5.5 Ω resistor. Find current, terminal PD, power delivered to load, and power wasted in battery
questions.correctAnswer: Total R = 6 Ω. I = 12/6 = 2 A. Terminal V = IR_load = 2x5.5 = 11 V. P_load = I^2R = 4x5.5 = 22 W. P_battery = I^2r = 4x0.5 = 2 W. Check: P_total = εI = 24 W = 22+2
questions.explanation: Total R = 6 Ω. I = 12/6 = 2 A. Terminal V = IR_load = 2x5.5 = 11 V. P_load = I^2R = 4x5.5 = 22 W. P_battery = I^2r = 4x0.5 = 2 W. Check: P_total = εI = 24 W = 22+2

questions.question: [Mechanics and Motion] A 0.5 kg ball is projected at 20 m/s at 30 deg to horizontal. Find maximum height, range, and speed at impact
questions.correctAnswer: uₓ = 20cos30 deg = 10sqrt3 ≈ 17.32 m/s; uᵧ = 20sin30 deg = 10 m/s. Max height: vᵧ^2 = uᵧ^2 - 2gh -> 0 = 100 - 19.6h -> h = 5.10 m. Time of flight: t = 2uᵧ/g = 20/9.8 = 2.04 s. Range = uₓ x t = 17.32 x 2.04 = 35.3 m. At impact: vᵧ = -10 m/s, v = sqrt(17.32^2 + 10^2) = 20 m/s
questions.explanation: uₓ = 20cos30 deg = 10sqrt3 ≈ 17.32 m/s; uᵧ = 20sin30 deg = 10 m/s. Max height: vᵧ^2 = uᵧ^2 - 2gh -> 0 = 100 - 19.6h -> h = 5.10 m. Time of flight: t = 2uᵧ/g = 20/9.8 = 2.04 s. Range = uₓ x t = 17.32 x 2.04 = 35.3 m. At impact: vᵧ = -10 m/s, v = sqrt(17.32^2 + 10^2) = 20 m/s

questions.question: [Particles and Quantum Physics] Electrons accelerated through 150 V. Find de Broglie wavelength and explain if diffraction observable
questions.correctAnswer: λ = h/sqrt(2meV) = 6.63x10⁻^3⁴ / sqrt(2x9.11x10⁻^3¹x1.6x10⁻¹⁹x150) ≈ 1.0x10⁻¹⁰ m = 0.1 nm. Comparable to atomic spacing -> diffraction observable (e.g. Davisson-Germer)
questions.explanation: λ = h/sqrt(2meV) = 6.63x10⁻^3⁴ / sqrt(2x9.11x10⁻^3¹x1.6x10⁻¹⁹x150) ≈ 1.0x10⁻¹⁰ m = 0.1 nm. Comparable to atomic spacing -> diffraction observable (e.g. Davisson-Germer)

questions.question: [Thermal Physics] 2 moles of ideal gas at 300 K compressed isothermally from 0.02 m^3 to 0.01 m^3. Find work done
questions.correctAnswer: Isothermal: W = ∫PdV = ∫(nRT/V)dV = nRT ln(V₂/V₁) = 2x8.31x300xln(0.5) = -3457 J. Work done ON gas = +3457 J
